hero.headline: Crafting Sustainable Elegance from Northern Bengal
hero.subheading: Direct factory manufacturer and exporter of handcrafted storage baskets, planters, and home living collections. Ethically created by master rural women artisans since 2011.

exportBanner.headline: "Ethically Handmade | Naturally Beautiful | Certified for Global Standards"
exportBanner.description: Exporting handmade excellence from Northern Bangladesh since 2011. Direct manufacturers of wild Kaisa grass storage baskets, coiled seagrass hampers, braided golden jute planters, and sustainable lifestyle carry goods.

heritage.title: Preserving Ancestral Looming in Kaunia, Rangpur
heritage.p1: Rooted along the fertile riverbanks of Northern Bangladesh, our craft preserves centuries of horizontal pit-loom weaving, wild grass foraging, and natural rope braiding.
heritage.p2: Over 85% of our workforce consists of skilled rural female artisans who gain independent livelihood, healthcare, and fair wages under strict ethical fair-trade conditions.

esg.sdg1: Steady living wages directly paid to rural craft households across Northern Bengal.
esg.sdg5: Empowering 85%+ rural female artisans with leadership and financial independence.
esg.sdg12: 100% biodegradable natural fibers replacing non-recyclable petroleum plastics.
esg.sdg13: Carbon-negative golden jute handloomed without industrial greenhouse emissions.
